answer_as_filed: The information presented above provides an overview of the programs and services that are made possible, in part, through savings generated by the 340B Drug Pricing Program. For The University of Toledo Medical Center (UTMC), the 340B Program is not a discrete revenue source or a stand-alone funding mechanism. Rather, it is an integral component of the organization's financial structure that helps sustain access to care for Medicaid beneficiaries, uninsured individuals, and other medically complex and underserved patients.In fiscal year 2025, UToledo Health reported an operating income of approximately $5.4 million. The savings generated through the 340B Program play a critical role in supporting this financial stability and are reinvested to maintain essential clinical services, expand access to care, and offset the significant costs associated with caring for a high proportion of government-insured and uninsured patients. Without these savings, UTMC's ability to sustain many of the programs and services described in this report and to continue providing comprehensive, high-quality care to the residents of Northwest Ohio; would be significantly challenged
